name: mica
description: Mica — a Git-native content editor for Astro websites.
//type: No `type: module` here, deliberately: Rush generates the CommonJS bundles in common/scripts/, and this manifest is the scope they run in. The repository's own scripts are `.mjs`, which declares them ES modules by itself; every package sets its own `type`.
//: Rush drives this repository — see rush.json. There are no root scripts and no root node_modules: `rush update` installs, `rush build` builds, `rush test` tests, and the repository's own commands live in common/config/rush/command-line.json.
//backup: There is no backup script: the content is in Git, and the database holds only sessions.
